title: Super Soul 121 PQ 138/151 acquisition reconciliation
target: I'm not gonna die until I defeat you!
finding: The endpoint's canonical acquisition metadata contained a stale historical PQ 151 attribution in addition to the current PQ 138 attribution. Current PQ 138 reward evidence confirms the Super Soul; current DLC documentation also places it at PQ 138. The canonical acquisition index correctly retained only PQ 138, while the unified reverse index had omitted the target entirely.
correction: Restored the reverse index entry to PQ 138 only. No PQ 151 relationship was added.

evidence.finding: PQ 138 basic rewards explicitly list I'm not gonna die until I defeat you!.

evidence.source: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 Wiki — The Battle for Earth
